question: What form does the knower aspect take when situated in the supreme part?
premises: The knower part is situated in many ways within the supreme part.
Because of that situation, it becomes predominant as both supreme and non-supreme.
In that state it takes the form of a lord of mantras.
inference: When the knower aspect abides in the supreme, it manifests as the mantreśa level characterized by the supreme-and-non-supreme.
plain_english: Because the knower part is situated in many ways within the supreme part, it becomes predominant as supreme-and-non-supreme and takes the form of a lord of mantras.
